Because CORTEX_API_URL is empty on BOTH staging and production property-explorer projects (verified both), both fall to the same hardcoded default host -- i.e. staging and production property-explorer hit the IDENTICAL Cloud Run endpoint.

That endpoint is Cloud Run service `cortex-api`, project `legacy-design-tools-prod` (NOT hauska-prod-497015 -- it has zero Cloud Run services matching cortex-api). `gcloud run services describe` shows ONE revision at 100% traffic (cortex-api-00745-cud, tag `canary`) -- a single shared database connection for every caller regardless of which Vercel project or API key called it (confirmed via legacy-design-tools' brokerageServiceAuth.ts: auth classifies caller tier, never selects a database).

Repointing to it is a materially different, larger action than 'set a Vercel env var and redeploy' -- it is a Cloud Run change on a different repo (legacy-design-tools) serving live production traffic on its default (untagged) URL, outside this dispatch's stated scope and action plan.
